# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 17 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Greek MS | **Section:** Jacob Blesses Aseneth

---

**17:1** Jacob came to Egypt in the second year of the famine, on the new moon of the fourth month. Joseph went out to meet his father.

**17:2** Joseph said to his father: 'Come in to Pentephres the priest of Heliopolis, for his daughter Aseneth is my wife.' Jacob said: 'Bring her to me, that I may bless her.'

**17:3** Aseneth came to Jacob and bowed before him. Jacob looked at her and said: 'Come close, my daughter.' He stretched out his right hand, placed it on her head, and said: 'Blessed are you by the Lord God Most High.'

**17:4** 'The Lord God will bless the man who is your husband forever and ever, and the Lord God will bless your sons and daughters to come from you forever and ever.'

**17:5** Jacob kissed Aseneth, took her right hand, and led her into the house of Joseph.

**17:6** All the sons of Jacob came and bowed before Aseneth and said: 'Blessed is our sister, for our father and our God has blessed you, and God has established you forever.'

**17:7** Simeon and Levi, the sons of Leah, loved Aseneth greatly above all the sons of Jacob, and they became close friends with her.

---
